{{short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Ragnvald Karl Olav Høier''' (30 November 1938 – 23 October 2009) was a Norwegian physicist.

He graduated from the [[University of Oslo]] with the [[cand.real.]] degree in 1965, and took the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1973. He was appointed as professor at the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] (later known as [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]]) in 1983. He was also involved at [[SINTEF]].<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=2007|title=Ragnvald Karl Olav Høier|authorlink=Øyvind Grøn|first=Øyvind|last=Grøn|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]]|editor=Henriksen, Petter|publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget|location=Oslo|url=http://www.snl.no/Ragnvald_Karl_Olav_H%C3%B8ier|accessdate=24 December 2009}}</ref>
